data.description: Once per day an ayngavhaul can attempt to summon 2d6 imps, 1d4 bearded devils, or 2 bone devils with an 80%% chance of success, or a contract devil (see Pathfinder Adventure Path volume #12) with a 45%% chance of success. This ability is the equivalent of a 6th-level spell.
data.name: Summon Devil
